messages:
jamal: FYI — incident in eu1 caused intermittent 503s on inference nodes. Pausing today's release (v2.14.0) globally and pinning the change window. Need ops + QA to sign off before we pick a new window. @maria @alex

maria: thanks. do we have the scope split for this release? is there anything FE-only we can still ship to us-west? :thinking:

deploy-bot: deploybot action: HOLD initiated by jamal for release v2.14.0. Reason: incident-eu1-503.
```
/deploy hold v2.14.0 --reason "incident eu1 503"
Status: canary paused, global rollout paused
```

sre-oncall: quick update from infra — nginx upstreams on eu1 started returning 502/503 after KV cache eviction spike. We're still seeing elevated error-rate in the canary (eu). 1/3 canary hosts 503s, others degraded latency.

alex: if infra approves, we can consider pinned rollback of model-serving to v2.13.7 in EU only (hotfix path). That would be a targeted revert (no DB migrations). QA would need a rapid smoke.

maria: proposed plan: 1) hold global rollout (done). 2) attempt targeted rollback in EU to v2.13.7 behind a canary; if canary healthy for 15m, promote. 3) once EU stable, stagger US rollout + release notes update that model version was pinned due to incident. Is 2h ops window OK? :clock2:

ops-bot: reschedule-request received. Tentative windows submitted: EU rollback canary 18:00-18:30 UTC, EU promote 18:30-19:00 UTC, US staggered rollout 19:30-20:00 UTC. Please confirm owners.

jamal: assigning: @sre-oncall to run rollback canary, @maria to own QA smoke, @alex to monitor model outputs for regression. I'll update the release notes and inform customer-facing channels.

sre-oncall: ack — starting pre-rollback checks now. will post quick checklist: 
- snapshot canary logs
- snapshot model-version hash
- set traffic cut to 10% for rollback canary

maria: QA will be on standby, can do smoke + a couple of regression prompts. if rollback introduces regressions, we'll halt.

alex: one caveat — if we fallback model version we need to toggle the new KV-cache opt-out flag in eu only. ops will need to flip feature-flag during rollback.

jamal: noted. ops + sre to coordinate flag flip in the canary before promoting. I'll add an entry to release notes: "Deployment paused due to eu1 infra errors; targeted rollback to v2.13.7 if canary passes; reschedule windows posted."

maria: thanks. I'll ping customer success once EU is stable. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: update: canary status at 17:34 UTC — eu canary 1/3 hosts failing (503). Holding.

sre-oncall: update 17:36 UTC — created snapshots, preparing rollback runbook. will attempt canary rollback at 18:00 UTC as scheduled.

jamal: good. I'll mark the release pinned in the console and add an ops note. Keeping this thread open for updates.
